Find me 5 weekend trek options near Pune with difficulty and cost
11:11 AM

Here are 5 easy treks that work as day trips from Pune:

Sinhagad, 30 km. About 1.5–2 hours up, and the closest of the five. Famous for sunrise.
Lohagad, 65 km. A wide, well-marked trail of about 1.5 hours up. Malavli railway station is close.
Tikona, 60 km. Short but steep near the top, with a 360° view and fewer crowds.
Korigad, 70 km. An easy, wide path with views of Lonavala lake. Good for families.
Rajmachi, 85 km. Two forts on one plateau. It is the farthest, and many people camp overnight, so start early for a day trip.

It is winter now, so trails are dry and the views are clear. Expect crowds through Oct and Nov. If you want a bit more challenge, Visapur is moderate and sits next to Lohagad, so you can do both in one day.

Source: Weekend Wander, dated Sun 31 May 2026.
